verdict.rationale: Morph provides first-party, detailed docs for integrating with coding agents: native /v1/messages support for Claude Code, MCP server setup for Claude Code and other tools, Codex integration via edit_file tool, and OpenAI-SDK-compatible endpoints for arbitrary agent frameworks. This is corroborated by community usage reports (e.g., goose author using it with multiple agent stacks) and a dedicated coding-agents guide page. Missing for 10: broader independent verification across more agent frameworks beyond Claude Code/Codex/goose, and some community friction reports on edit accuracy.
